formal_object.rationale: IID Bernoulli group rewards and action-independent score baselines define two limited estimator facts.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: B05: Probability of a mixed group is 1-p^G-(1-p)^G. Condition: IID reward draws at fixed policy E03: Minimize E[(R-b)^2||h||^2] over b. Condition: b is action-independent and E||h||^2>0

derivation.rationale: Mixed probability and weighted variance-optimal baseline are correct under the stated law; rejecting nonmixed groups changes that law.

assumptions.rationale: IID Bernoulli is only a diagnostic model; actual correlated graded/native rewards need their own estimator law. Policy support and square-integrable scores justify E[h]=0. Selection/rejection of all-equal groups changes the sampling measure. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: An unbiased support-preserving gradient update after adaptive group rejection is absent. The two identities do not yet specify a complete training method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Only the IID nondegenerate-group frequency law is established; a method benefit per generated token remains a lead. Falsification: Biased group selection, reward correlations or extra rollouts erasing estimator efficiency refute the proposed rationale.

closest_alternative.rationale: GRPO/DAPO are actual alternatives, but their full estimator/author-code/reward comparison remains unresolved. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
claim_scope: Conditional formal construction only. No code/test/design/result/native-parent qualification.
